checks.name: Complete migration executes on PostgreSQL with minimal Supabase schema stubs
Two independent approvals admit their accounts; an unapproved third account is rejected
Additive language upgrade preserves existing profile values and leaves each preference independently unset
Finnish/Swedish preferences remain owner-only, reject unsupported codes, preserve timezone/currency and export correctly
Owner operations create images, outfits, wear history and feedback with real constraints
A/B cannot read, change or delete each other across all ten private public tables; own records remain
Forged ownership, foreign FKs/RPCs/images/admission access and service-only deletion are denied in both directions
Consistent export snapshots contain only the authenticated owner across every exported table
Atomic writes reject stale versions; identical retry succeeds; restored history uses a restricted import path
Image-state edits/overwrites, invalid timezone and future worn events are rejected
Feedback signatures are derived from owned item IDs; retired photo recovery starts at retirement and retries do not reset it
Permanent item deletion preserves owner history text with a null item link and removes current outfit references
Anonymous role cannot read any private table or export RPC
All twelve application tables have RLS enabled
No relationship tables, recipient/household/peer columns or peer-discovery RPC exist
Disabling A blocks its old user context immediately and leaves B unaffected
Deletion controller enforces file-before-row-before-Auth stages, removes only A and safely retries completion (Storage metadata stub only)
Live Supabase Auth/REST/Storage and implemented browser/deletion function
